contexts.text: Adam (in the celestial Word) = the Lord as to the Divine Itself and at the same time as to the Divine Human; and his wife = the Church...
In the genealogy in Luke, it is said that Adam was of God, that is, created by God, and not the son of God.
To deduce (the origin of all evils from Adam and his seed) would be like deriving all species of birds from one egg...
